summary: Adds a thumbnail helper that shells out to ImageMagick convert, a docs URL setting, and a /calc endpoint that evaluates an arithmetic expression from the query string.

findings.title: Server evaluates request query string as JavaScript
findings.problem: The /calc handler passes req.query.expr straight to eval. The added comments switch off the checks that would report it.
findings.consequence: Any caller can run arbitrary code inside the Node process. That caller can then read secrets, change data or take over the host.
findings.fix: Parse the expression with a restricted arithmetic evaluator such as expr-eval. Reject any input that contains characters other than digits, operators, parentheses and spaces.

findings.title: Shell command built from uploaded file name
findings.problem: make_thumbnail puts upload_name, which comes from the upload form, into a shell command string. subprocess.run then runs that string through the shell.
findings.consequence: A user can upload a file named with shell metacharacters such as a semicolon. The shell then runs that user's commands on the server.
findings.fix: Pass an argument list to subprocess.run without shell=True. Also reduce upload_name to its base name so a crafted name cannot escape the upload and thumbnail folders.
findings.suggested_change:
name = os.path.basename(upload_name)
    subprocess.run(["convert", f"{UPLOAD_DIR}/{name}", "-resize", "128x128", f"{THUMB_DIR}/{name}"], check=True)

findings.title: New endpoint and thumbnail helper have no tests
findings.problem: This change adds the /calc endpoint and make_thumbnail. The repository has no test that runs either one.
findings.consequence: Nothing will catch an injection fix or a behaviour change that breaks them.
findings.fix: Add tests that call /calc with valid and hostile expressions. Add tests that call make_thumbnail with a name holding shell metacharacters.
